name: gh_pr_review_create
description: Create a pending (draft) pull request review with inline comments. The review remains in draft on GitHub until submitted via gh_pr_review_submit.

repo.description: Optional OWNER/REPO. Defaults to the repository of the current directory.

comments.description: Array of inline review comments to attach to the review.

path.description: The relative path of the file to comment on.

line.description: The line number in the diff to comment on (last line for multi-line).

side.description: Optional diff side: LEFT or RIGHT (default RIGHT).

start_line.description: Optional first line for a multi-line comment.
